changeScope: Published reviewed 1.2 payload to the existing owner-private site. No DNS or audience changes.
currentEvidence: Sites get_site reports the custom URL as current_live_url. Authenticated HTTPS landing/game and actual ZIP/PDF downloads passed in desktop Chrome.

access.basis: Successful owner-private deployment followed by get_site: active, version 5, one owner, no groups or external visitors. No access change.

saveScope: Ordinary page reload at this same browser and origin. No save injection or snapshot restore. Browser storage does not synchronize across origins or devices. Native same-session Continue is recorded separately.
limitations: Hosted delivery, launch, bounded controls and same-origin checkpoint upgrade/reload. Full 72-room Story and 12-sector Arcade qualification is native; browser gameplay qualification remains the separately recorded eight Story rooms and one Arcade sector. No new full browser campaign, native cold-boot, browser-process shutdown, other-device/browser, heard-audio or physical-device coverage.
